title: SiteBoundaryStatusRisk
description: Contract for the Stage 1 Brain Completion Batch — site-boundary status risk rule. Contract version 1.0.0, same convention as Slices 1-5. Canonical source of truth: this file, in Project-Check-Brain.

SiteBoundaryStatusInput.description: The raw p.facts.siteBoundaryStatus value. Inequality against the single literal 'confirmed' — every other value ('skipped', empty string, null, undefined, or an unrecognised value) must produce the risk. Not narrowed to a 'skipped'-only allowlist.

RiskOutput.description: The risk this rule contributes to p.risks1, or null when siteBoundaryStatus === 'confirmed'.

text.const: The relevant site boundary has not yet been confirmed on a site map, so boundary-related constraints are not yet confirmed.
